originalFinding.title: Sender-local protection caption prematurely claims receipt
originalFinding.rationale: The metadata object label is Received protected resource metadata, but this owner is prm-protect: sender-local encryption/derivation before wire transfer. Arabic استلام in the action caption incorrectly suggests receipt at this step. Use جلب for the exchange purpose while retaining sender-local protection and not renaming the canonical payload.
